# hestiacp_cron_job (Resource)

Manages a cron job for a HestiaCP user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Shell command to execute.
- `day` (String) Day of month field (1-31 or `*`).
- `hour` (String) Hour field (0-23 or `*`).
- `min` (String) Minute field (0-59 or `*`).
- `month` (String) Month field (1-12 or `*`).
- `wday` (String) Day of week field (0-6, Sunday=0, or `*`).

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
